name: How Long We Will Live
overview: Scripture reveals that the length of human life is determined and limited by God, as seen in Genesis 6:3 where the LORD sets a span of 120 years for mankind. Job 14:5 emphasizes that God has appointed the boundaries of our days which we cannot exceed, while Psalm 90:10 acknowledges the typical human lifespan as seventy to eighty years marked by labor and sorrow. Yet, Psalm 139:16 affirms that God has ordained our days even before we are formed, underscoring His sovereign control. In contrast, John 10:28 offers the hope of eternal life through Christ, assuring believers that this life transcends earthly limitations and cannot be taken away.
